title: Counterexamples to Strongly Continuous Many-Fermion Dynamics
exact_target: Find an unregularized fermion interaction and states exhibiting the requested failure of strong continuity.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006191 (OWR-14299085-005). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mini-Workshop: New Directions in Correlated Quantum Systems (2025), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2025/7, pp. 339--374. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The primary report explicitly distinguishes operator-norm continuity from strong operator continuity. Self-adjointness of a represented Hamiltonian supplies the latter and does not automatically settle the former. Related record 30006190 asks about cutoff removal.
